title: Run!
description: NCERT Class 4 English (Marigold): 'Run!'. New words, comprehension, adverbs (how), and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'Run!': race, speed, finish, cheer.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'Run!' mean (race, speed, finish, cheer); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: When a crowd shouts happily for you, they ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: She ran quickly to the finish line.
He spoke loudly so everyone could hear.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'Run!' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'Run!'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The poem 'Run!' is full of energy and ___.
The poem 'Run!' is full of energy and ___.

exemplars: She ran quickly to the finish line.
He spoke loudly so everyone could hear.

nodes.title: Adverbs (How)
nodes.teach_focus: An adverb tells HOW an action is done: quickly, slowly, loudly, carefully.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses adverbs (how) correctly in a sentence.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Which word tells HOW she ran?
The tortoise walked ___. (in a slow way)
bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: She ran quickly to the line.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'Run!'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'Run!': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: In the race, I ran very ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The tortoise walked ___. (in a slow way)
bridge_exercises.context: A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: She ran quickly to the finish line.
He spoke loudly so everyone could hear.
